author: Ccabhx
title: Predatory Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment (DDA)
content: Don't waste your time. This game uses covert Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment (DDA). This game feels like a money grab and they are doing whatever they can to get any amount of money possible. If you’re looking for fun, don’t waste your time with this one.

Luckily if you lose a level enough, it’ll simplify it for you so you don’t get stuck on these levels. Speaking of power-ups, they are not that great. The bomb and multi-color blaster do not do enough to make a difference. You should add one that allows you to add an extra space. Also, they cost way too much in-game money to purchase and I refuse to use real money to buy anything. Last thing, ads after each level is a bit much. Main takeaways:
Some levels too difficult 

The power-ups aren’t that helpful and need improvement 

Too many ads

You would think you could just buy some power ups with the in-game currency, but they give you so little (even for hard levels), that it takes forever to get enough to buy power ups. And if you can’t get past a level, you can’t get the currency to buy power ups, anyway. I’ve been stuck on this level 64 puzzle for 3 days now. I get to the point I’ve got 7-9 jellies on the board and trying to keep them in play while trying to get new ones up that I need. I literally used my last few power ups trying to get through this puzzle. They got me close, but not all the way. Now, without any power ups, I can’t even get halfway through the puzzle. This is probably the 6th game like this that I ended up quitting because it always gets like this. It’s no fun, not being able to get through the puzzles, so it’s a delete for me. Maybe I’ll find one that’s not like this. I want to play the game, not be constantly stuck unless I’m buying hundreds of dollars of in-game currency.
